anika_cs: Kicking off HeliosFoundry dedicated bring-up. High level: quota plan, mirroring strategy, and a gradual cutover to avoid flapping. Need agreement on static vs autoscale lanes. @tom_infra @lucas_sre
tom_infra: We can reserve 6xH100s in dedicated-eu-1 for the three-day priming window. Suggest two lanes: steady (min=3) and burst (scale to 10). Need signed SOC and KMS details to enable private pool.
lucas_sre: Proposed migration flow: 1) traffic mirror (10%) for 2h, 2) stepped increase 10->50->100% with 15m holds, 3) 6h soak at full. Canary route should route 1% initially to avoid client-side surprises. Also define SLOs: p95 < 300ms, error rate <0.5%.
perf_qa: I'll run two sets of load runs: synthetic Locust replay and production-replay using sanitized traces. Locust snippet:
```
from locust import HttpUser, task, between
class CustomerUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = between(1,2)
    @task
    def infer(self):
        self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={"prompt":"<sample>"})
```
Will attach CSVs for latency, tokens, model_io per run.
rory_eng: Helios will supply a 48k prompt set for replay. They'll need guidance on sanitization. Sam from their infra asked about warm KV cache — how to prime?
anika_cs: Ask Helios to send top 200 prompt prefixes; we'll pre-warm prefix cache during shadow run. Also capture any custom tool calls in the corpus.
kevin_account: Renewal note: account exec flagged that a clean priming helps their Q2 decision. Please add a short exec-ready summary after soak.
tom_infra: Autoscale detail: scale metric = tokens_per_min_per_gpu with min_instances=3 max_instances=10, cooldown=45s. For route overflow, fallback to quantized-8bit model. We should whitelist which customers can hit fallback.
lucas_sre: Add alarm: GPU_mem_pressure > 85% for 2m -> paging to oncall. Also track KV cache hit% and token cost/min.
perf_qa: Smoke scheduled Tue 04/12 06:00 UTC (30m). Full replay Wed 04/13 02:00-08:00 UTC. I need a temporary quota bump: 1.5M tokens/day for Wed only.
tom_infra: Approved bump for replay window. ops: apply quota window rule and remove after 04/13 09:00 UTC.
devops-bot: Quota rule created: q-bump-3512346789, expires 2024-04-13T09:00:00Z. Pool reservation: ded-eu1-hf-3512346789 confirmed.
perf_qa: After smoke: CPU/GPU ratios looked fine, but prefix hit only 8% on initial run. I'll run targeted primer job to raise it.
lucas_sre: For cutover plan: holdback policy = 10% increments every 20m if p95 < SLO and errors < 0.3%. If breached, rollback window 15m to previous stable route.
anika_cs: I'll coordinate enablement session with Helios' ML lead Thurs 11:00 UTC — will cover runbook, escalation, and cost expectations. Please add the billing estimate for the soak so they see delta.
kevin_account: Added to CRM: renewal_risk=medium -> mitigation: successful soak + exec summary.
rory_eng: One more ask: can we enable request-id forwarding so Helios can map traces? They'll need a header.
tom_infra: Yes, we'll insert X-Helios-ReqId passthrough. Make sure it's rate-limited in logs to avoid PII.
perf_qa: Logs & artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-loadtests/helios/3512346789/, I'll post links after each run.
anika_cs: Thanks team — sync notes and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helios-dedicated-cutover. I'll send the exec summary template after the soak. :white_check_mark:
